$schemaDescription: G3.3 -- Single source of truth for the BLE telemetry notification packet. All three implementations (src/BLETelemetryPacket.h, mobile_app/app.js, mobile_app/flutter_app/lib/models/telemetry_data.dart) must match this file exactly and reference it by path in a comment. Also intended as a machine-readable format for future tooling (e.g. a TinyML training-data pipeline that decodes logged BLE packets without hand-maintaining a second copy of this layout).

versioning.rule: Receivers MUST read `version` first and reject/drop the packet if it does not match the version they were built against. Any change to field order, size, or meaning below requires incrementing `version` here and in all three implementations together.

sequenceNumber.rule: Rolls over 0-255. Receivers track the last seen seq and compute (currentSeq - lastSeq - 1) mod 256 as the number of packets lost since the previous one, to measure BLE notification loss.

fields.name: version
fields.description: Packet format version. Must equal `version` above; receivers reject the packet otherwise.

fields.name: seq
fields.description: Rolling 0-255 counter incremented once per packet sent; used to detect and count lost BLE notifications.

fields.name: coolantTemp
fields.description: Coolant temperature in degrees Celsius, range -40 to 150.

fields.name: leanAngle
fields.description: Current roll/lean angle in tenths of a degree, e.g. 254 = 25.4 degrees.

fields.name: maxLeanRight
fields.description: Peak right lean angle in tenths of a degree.

fields.name: maxLeanLeft
fields.description: Peak left lean angle in tenths of a degree.
